sentence: Lets chat members sign up for or drop out of a fixed set of dated games, with a cap of six players per game and a live list of who is in each.
use_when: A group wants to see who is playing in each of a few set game dates
Players need to join or leave a date with a limited number of spots
Organizing a weekly pickup sport or regular meetup with a player cap
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote on which date or time works best
The dates or spot limit need to be changed or added by members
Teams, scores or brackets need to be tracked
